review_evidence: Reviewed all 33 primary Lean files; the repository contains three competing formalizations of Smullyan knights-and-knaves puzzles with extensive custom set/propositional theorem libraries and solved puzzle statements.
The root and Build modules are import/navigation surfaces and are retained; no lossless noise subtree was established.
summary: Reviewed Raymond Smullyan KnightsAndKnaves and retained the complete formal puzzle/theorem corpus.
